scripts.//deploy: `run` is REQUIRED here: bare `pnpm --filter x deploy` resolves to pnpm's own built-in deploy command, not the package script, and fails with ERR_PNPM_INVALID_DEPLOY_TARGET.
scripts.deploy:vercel: pnpm --filter @playstack/web exec vercel build --prod && pnpm --filter @playstack/web exec vercel deploy --prebuilt --prod
scripts.audit:rls: cd tools && uv run playstack-ops audit-rls
scripts.status: cd tools && uv run playstack-ops status
